purpose: Propagation crown pixel regression and accuracy evaluation only.
label_provenance: Independent visual inspection of physical crown pixels. No detector outputs, filename family labels, seed CSV records, or family database inferences supply ground truth.
coordinate_convention: Pixels in each saved crop. Socket positions are one-based; first_x is the first socket center. Geometry is manual and approximate. Crop coordinates refer to the original label-view panel, with unchanged pixel dimensions and no rescaling.
